questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

questions.q: The Right to Property was removed from the list of Fundamental Rights by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 44th Amendment (1978) removed Article 31. Property is now a legal right under Article 300A.

questions.q: Which Articles cannot be suspended even during a national emergency?
questions.explanation: After the 44th Amendment, Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended during a national emergency.

questions.q: In which case did the Supreme Court declare the Right to Privacy a Fundamental Right?
questions.explanation: A nine-judge bench in K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017) held privacy to be part of Article 21.

questions.q: Article 21A (free and compulsory education for children aged 6–14) was added by:
questions.explanation: The 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 inserted Article 21A.
